profile.name: Keithley 6514 静电计
profile.description: Keithley 6514 是一款高灵敏度静电计，可进行微弱电流、电荷、电压和电阻测量。它常用于低电平电学测试、漏电流表征、绝缘材料评估以及需要高输入阻抗和高分辨率的实验测量。
profile.description_en: The Keithley 6514 is a high-sensitivity electrometer for measuring very small currents, charge, voltage, and resistance. It is commonly used for low-level electrical measurements, leakage current characterization, insulation testing, and experiments requiring high input impedance and high resolution.
